COOKIES.TITLE: Cookies Policy
COOKIES.P1: Cookies are small files that can be stored on the user's device when visiting a website.
COOKIES.P1-2: They can be used to enable certain functionalities, remember preferences, or collect information about navigation.
COOKIES.P2TITLE: Use of Cookies in RIVILLA art studio
COOKIES.P2: Currently, this website has a primarily informational purpose and does not use its own cookies for analysis, advertising, or profiling.
COOKIES.P2-2: Moreover, RIVILLA art studio does not use analytics or advertising tools based on cookies to track the navigation of website users.
COOKIES.P3: This website may contain links to services and platforms of third parties, such as Instagram, Linktree, or Google Maps.
COOKIES.P3-2: These links direct to external websites, and once the user accesses them, the privacy policies and cookies policies of their respective providers apply.
COOKIES.P3-3: RIVILLA art studio does not control the cookies or technologies used by these external sites. It is recommended to consult their respective privacy policies and cookies policies.
